source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of bar charts (PDF 197-198).

blocks.text: Bar chart categorical data ko mustateel bars se dikhata hai jin ki lambai ya unchai qeemat ke mutanasib hoti hai. Yeh alag qismon mein miqdar ka muqabla karta hai, jaise species ki ginti, tajrubati groups ya namoonon ki naap. Qismein x-axis par, qeematein ya frequencies y-axis par, aur bars khari ya leti ho sakti hain.

blocks.caption: Keeron ki species ki nisbati tadaad (kitab ka data)

items: Maqsad aur data: paanch keeron ki tadaad ka muqabla; categorical variable species aur numerical variable ginti hai.
Axes: x-axis par species, y-axis par afraad ki tadaad.
Paimana: sab se bari qeemat 120 (cheentiyan), is liye y-axis 0 se 140 tak 20 ke qadmon mein.
Bars: har bar apni qeemat tak, barabar chaurai aur yaksan faasle ke saath.
Naam aur unwan: unwan 'Insect species abundance in local forest'; x-axis 'Insect species'; y-axis 'Number of individuals'.

blocks.alt: Bar chart: INSECT SPECIES ABUNDANCE IN LOCAL FOREST. Y-axis Number of individuals (afraad ki tadaad), 0 se 140 tak 20 ke qadmon mein; x-axis Insect species. Paanch rangeen bars: Ladybug 45 (16%), Ant 120 (41%), Butterfly 30 (10%), Bee 75 (26%), Dragonfly 20 (7%); har bar ke oopar feesad aur paanchon species ka rangon wala legend.
blocks.caption: Maqami jangal mein keeron ki species ki nisbati tadaad ka bar chart (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke chhape chart mein y-axis par 'Abundance (%)' likha hai, lekin bars ginti (45, 120, 30, 75, 20) tak jati hain aur kitab ke qadam bhi y-axis ka naam 'Number of individuals' batate hain; is liye yahan sahih naam 'Number of individuals' likha hai. Bars ke oopar feesad 290 keeron mein se hissa hai (maslan 120/290 = 41%). Kitab ke legend mein sirf teen species (Ladybug, Ant, Butterfly) thin; yahan paanchon ka legend poora kiya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Legend
blocks.text: Legend chart, graph ya naqshe par aik kunji hai jo istemal shuda alamaton, rangon, namoonon ya naamon ka matlab batati hai, maslan bar chart mein kaun sa rang kis qisam ka hai.

blocks.prompt: 290 keeron mein cheentiyan 120 hain. Un ka feesad jaanchein.
blocks.explanation: 120 / 290 x 100 = 41.4, taqreeban 41%, jaisa table mein hai.

items: Bar chart: x par qismein, y par qeematein, barabar bars.
Sab se bari qeemat se zara oopar tak paimana; unwan, axes ke naam aur zaroorat ho to legend.
